stories.title: AI is imposing a hidden ‘cognitive tax’ on the lowest-paid workers
summary: We need to rethink welfare for an economy being reshaped by AI.Throughout the history of the study of economics, the human brain, which directs our labour, judgment and resilience, has rarely been considered an asset in its own right.
The emerging AI economy is changing that.
As machines take on routine work, what becomes most valuable is the judgment, creativity and insights only people can provide.
